courses.title: Ayurvedic lifestyle analysis (Ayurvedisk livsstilsanalyse)
courses.description: A course of three meetings with the studio's Ayurveda practitioner, who trained with NAYA Ayurveda: a long first session that maps your constitution and present balance, a personal profile with recommendations, and a follow-up to fine-tune them. The work is on daily rhythm, food and habits, aiming at steadier energy, better rest and more calm. Single sessions can be booked afterwards.

left_out: Yoga-massage (875 kr / 975 kr, https://studieyoga.dk/hvad-er-yoga-massage/): a massage treatment (classical massage, Abhyanga and assisted stretches), not teaching; left out on scope, not health. Owner may decide otherwise.
Ayurveda information pages (De 3 doshaer, Ayurvediske opskrifter, Ayurveda – vejen til balance): background reading, not offerings or practices.
flags: Ayurvedic lifestyle analysis: the pages speak of sleep, digestion, stress, nervous-system unrest and 'hormonal imbalances' as things the guidance can support, in wellbeing terms; no claim to treat a disease, so kept under the 12 Nov rule.
Price as published: '3495kr incl. moms' for the three-session course (single follow-up sessions 975 kr); no currency code on the page. Booking is by email (info@studieyoga.dk).
The practitioner is the studio's own teacher writing in the first person ('Om mig'); she is not named on that page.
